purpose: Deterministic offline numeric performance evidence; assessment text, prompts, payloads, observations and full profiler listings are excluded.

method.initial_state: Unchanged shared source files/paths; pristine empty registry and acceptance ledger restored through SQLite backup before every sample; fixed service identity42; fresh process.
method.cache_state: OS page cache not flushed; warm filesystem behavior; frequency and thermals uncontrolled.
method.timers: Whole-run process CPU and monotonic wall; exclusive synchronous thread CPU; inclusive overlapping phase wall; async submission/retrieval latency without CPU attribution.
method.ordinary_instrumentation: Identical light phase hooks; no cProfile, tracemalloc, coverage or broad counters.
method.diagnostics: Single samples are diagnostic, not statistically reliable overhead or memory-improvement estimates.
method.metric_scope: Broad validation/hash/serialization/SQLite counters are profile-only; empty dictionaries in other modes mean unobserved, not zero. Task/queue tracking is profile/tracemalloc/combined; coverage-only and ordinary null values are unobserved. Four execution worker coroutines plus producer/consumer run per wave.
method.profiler: Default wall timer, builtins enabled, subcalls disabled; function wall timings can overlap; explicit thread-CPU phases are authoritative for CPU attribution.
method.prefix: 200 traits grouped by five; established 64 completed physical requests only, with bounded prepared/accepted in-flight requests reported.
method.baseline_provenance_limit: Some historical ordinary samples predate recorded tool-byte hashes; raw records explicitly mark retrospective compatibility of unchanged ordinary hooks. Six independently timestamped overlap samples were quarantined and replaced with fresh warm-ups.
method.json_bytes: Total JSON bytes includes canonical serialization as a subset; do not add them. Payload hashes count exact mock wire protocol bytes without retaining content.
method.wal: Profile-only observed registry WAL high-water after durable results, not continuous sampling; end-of-run sizes cannot establish transient peaks.
